Restored via select-all. PASS: Crowdfunding toggle — CryptoSelection with step '04' rendered OUTSIDE the accordion, accordion summary reads 'More options / Webhooks, redirect URL'. FAIL: tip-thankyou-card-download does NOT trigger a browser download (Playwright expect_download times out; anchor.click() is never invoked). Root cause: TipThankYouCard.tsx toBlob wrapper — `canvasRef.current?.toBlob((b)=>res(b), 'image/png') ?? res(null)` — canvas.toBlob() returns undefined, so the `??` right-hand side ALWAYS runs and immediately resolves the promise with null. In download(), `if (blob) { … a.click() }` is therefore never taken, so no download fires. The share() flow's file-branch (nav.canShare({files})) is also unreachable, and the twitter-fallback branch calls download() at the end which is a no-op. REGRESSION PASS: /devhub creator-support-widget + creator-noncustodial-note render; /devhub/shop grid renders; /pay/tip-card-demo not present in header/nav/footer; /about + /fees have 0 console errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Download button never triggers a real PNG download. `toBlob` wrapper `canvasRef.current?.toBlob(cb,'image/png') ?? res(null)` resolves immediately with null because canvas.toBlob() returns undefined, which makes `??` evaluate its right side. As a result `blob` is null, the anchor is never clicked, and (as a side effect) share()'s file-share branch and twitter-fallback's inline download are also broken.

critical_code_review_comments: TipThankYouCard.tsx L143: `canvas.toBlob(...) ?? res(null)` is a logic bug. `canvas.toBlob` is a void function, so the right side of `??` always runs and short-circuits the promise. Ship the fix above; otherwise 'Download card' + 'Share card' file-branch are dead code in every browser.

TipThankYouCard.tsx L150: the download anchor is not appended to the document before `.click()`. Chromium's download policy is generally OK with detached anchors, but Playwright's `expect_download` occasionally misses these — safer to append + remove.
CreatePaymentLink form 'Create' submit button has no data-testid — E2E has to rely on visible label matching. Recommend `data-testid=pay-link-create-btn` on the primary submit.

Native
element is used for pay-link-advanced-options (not MUI Accordion) — read state via `el.open`, click `> summary` to toggle. The `` works because it uses canvas.toDataURL, so the preview is fine even though the file-blob path is broken. The Playwright `expect_download` timeout is the reliable indicator that the download click never actually invokes an anchor — I proved this by monkey-patching document.createElement('a') and confirming zero clicks after pressing Download. When retesting the fix, also verify twitter fallback + downloadable PNG both fire.
rca of the issue:
In TipThankYouCard.tsx (line 143):
  const toBlob = useCallback(() => new Promise<Blob|null>((res) =>
    canvasRef.current?.toBlob((b) => res(b), 'image/png') ?? res(null)
  ), [])
canvas.toBlob() returns undefined. `undefined ?? res(null)` therefore *evaluates* `res(null)`, resolving the outer Promise with null synchronously (before the async toBlob callback fires). In download(): `const blob = await toBlob(); if (blob) { … a.click() }` — blob is always null, so a.click() never runs. Playwright's `expect_download` correctly times out. Fix by not using ?? here: check `canvasRef.current` explicitly and only call toBlob when non-null, e.g.: `const c = canvasRef.current; if (!c) { res(null); return; } c.toBlob(res, 'image/png')`.
